tagline: A leading global reinsurance and insurance organization with diversified portfolio and geographic presence across six continents.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross written premiums represent the primary indicator of Everest's underwriting scale and reach in the global reinsurance and insurance sector, generating $17.7 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Gross written premiums
kpis.explanation: Total amount of premiums underwritten by the company before deduction for reinsurance.
kpis.description: Represents the company's underwriting activity volume. Historical Gross written premiums data over 3 years, sourced from official financial pipeline.
kpis.signal: Gross written premiums have slightly decreased, indicating potential portfolio optimization.

kpis.name: Net written premiums
kpis.explanation: Gross written premiums minus ceded reinsurance portion.
kpis.description: Indicates underwriting revenue retained by the company after reinsurance.
kpis.signal: The slight decline in net written premiums reflects the strategy of focusing on core operations.

kpis.name: Premiums earned
kpis.explanation: Portion of written premiums corresponding to the insurance coverage period provided.
kpis.description: Represents revenue recognized over the coverage period.
kpis.signal: Growth in premiums earned suggests an increase in effective underwriting activity.

kpis.name: Net investment income
kpis.explanation: Income generated from the company's investments, net of fees.
kpis.description: A significant revenue source for insurance and reinsurance companies.
kpis.signal: Investment income continues to grow, supporting overall profitability.

kpis.name: Total revenues
kpis.explanation: Sum of earned premiums and investment income.
kpis.description: Comprehensive measure of the company's financial performance.
kpis.signal: Modest growth in total revenues, driven by investment income.

kpis.short: Incurred losses and loss adjustment expenses
kpis.name: Incurred losses and loss adjustment expenses
kpis.explanation: Cost of claims incurred and associated settlement expenses.
kpis.signal: Reduction in incurred losses is a positive sign for underwriting profitability.

kpis.name: Loss ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of earned premiums used to cover claims.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in loss ratio, indicating better control of claims costs.

kpis.name: Combined ratio
kpis.explanation: Sum of loss ratio and expense ratio.
kpis.description: Measures overall profitability of underwriting operations.
kpis.signal: Combined ratio returns below 100%, signaling restored underwriting profitability.

kpis.name: Shareholders equity
kpis.explanation: Net value of the company's assets after deduction of liabilities.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in shareholders' equity, reinforcing financial strength.

kpis.name: Book value per share
kpis.explanation: Portion of shareholders' equity attributable to each outstanding common share.
kpis.description: Measures the intrinsic value of the share.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in book value per share, indicating shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $2.0 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.335B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 21.1% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Annual consolidated revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $17.496B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Annual consolidated net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.591B in the latest year.

kpis.short: Sale of Commercial Retail Insurance Renewal Rights
kpis.name: Sale of Commercial Retail Insurance Renewal Rights
kpis.explanation: Amount received for the sale of renewal rights for certain commercial retail insurance lines. The transaction also includes additional rights in the European Union and transition services.
kpis.description: Sale to AIG of renewal rights for certain commercial insurance lines in the United States, the United Kingdom, Asia-Pacific, and the European Union, representing approximately $2 billion in gross premiums. AIG paid $252M for renewals in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Asia-Pacific, plus $30M for origination and structuring, and an additional $49M for renewals in the European Union. Transition services at $10M per month for 9 months starting January 2026.
kpis.signal: Strategic transaction to focus on core global reinsurance and specialty insurance operations.

kpis.name: Adverse Development Cover Reinsurance Agreements
kpis.explanation: Amount of reserves transferred under reinsurance agreements to cover potential adverse claim developments for accident years 2024 and prior.
kpis.description: Adverse development cover reinsurance agreement with State National Insurance Company and MS Transverse Insurance Company, covering reserves for Insurance and Other segments for accident years 2024 and prior up to $1.2 billion gross. The agreement includes three layers with an initial transfer of $1.25 billion in cash reserves (first layer). Additional layers cover $700M and $500M respectively with a $100M copay per layer. Designed to protect against unexpected claim developments and social inflation.
kpis.signal: Strengthened risk management related to adverse developments of prior-year claims, particularly in North American liability lines.

risks.title: Unforeseen catastrophic events
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned at the opening of the Risk Factors section. Language is strong ("catastrophic events", "materially and adversely affected"). Past losses are significant (up to $1.135B in 2021) and the risk is exacerbated by climate change. Industrial category heavily weighted in insurance financial services.

risks.title: Insufficient loss reserves
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the document, with explicit mention of a $657M reserve increase in 2025. Alarming language ("deficient", "charge to earnings", "reduction of capital"). Trend of increasing negative adjustments in 2024-2025. AE reserves particularly uncertain. Capital category = direct impact on solvency.

risks.title: Dependence on reinsurance
risks.score_rationale: Risk is detailed with quantitative data (12-13% of premiums ceded). Mentions unfavorable market conditions (inflation, capital loss among reinsurers). Concerning language ("may be substantially reduced"). Direct impact on underwriting capacity and loss protection. Credit category due to counterparty exposure.

risks.title: Underpricing of risks
risks.score_rationale: Key risk for an insurer, mentioned with concrete examples (AE, mass torts). Strong language ("net loss", "inadequate pricing"). Linked to structural trends such as social inflation. Strategic positioning in the text. Industrial category justified by core business.

risks.title: Downgrades in financial ratings
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section with mention of a *negative outlook* by A.M. Best, S&P, and Moody's. Contractual risk of termination or collateralization upon downgrade. Direct impact on competitiveness and cash flows. Reputation category due to partner confidence impact.

risks.title: Reinsurer credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention that risk transfer does not release the company from its obligation. Risk that reinsurers may not pay, even if capable. Concerning language ("significant loss"). Positioned in the financial section. Credit category is central.

risks.title: Financial market shocks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed financial section on asset volatility. Risk of realizing losses in case of forced liquidation. Mentions major macroeconomic factors (rates, inflation, spreads). Impact on liquidity and profitability. Capital category due to solvency linkage.

ai_positioning.summary: The company EG does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
